Athens.sights: Acropolis and Parthenon* | Areopagus (Mars Hill)* | Acropolis Museum* | Ancient Agora | Plaka and Anafiotika* | Syntagma Square and the changing of the guard | Athens Cathedral and the Little Metropolis | Monastiraki and the flea market | Temple of Olympian Zeus and Hadrian's Arch | Lycabettus Hill | Theatre of Dionysus | Acropolis promenade (Dionysiou Areopagitou and Apostolou Pavlou) | Agia Ekaterini (St Catherine's Church) | Panagia Kapnikarea | Roman Agora and Tower of the Winds | National Archaeological Museum | Byzantine and Christian Museum | National Garden | Philopappos Hill | Platonic Academy | Erechtheion | Panathenaic Stadium | Temple of Hephaestus | Kerameikos | Temple of Athena Nike | Classical Athens | Lyceum | Kaisariani monastery | National Gallery of Athens
Athens.far: Ancient Corinth | Temple of Poseidon at Sounion | Delphi | Corinth Canal | Acrocorinth | Museum | Ancient Theater | Temple of Apollo | Sanctuary of Athena with the Tholos | Delphi Stadium
